withdrawal_boundaries.withdrawal_excerpt:
# PR3 and PR4 recovered handoff review — 25 September 2026 — claims withdrawn

**Localization status reset — 28 September 2026: all previous progress, completion, repair, verification and no-defect conclusions for PRs #2–#9, #12 and #15 are withdrawn. Every item requires a full recheck; no previous progress is accepted.**

See the [individual recheck register](https://github.com/c933103/AN-Paint/blob/review/localization-integration/verification/localization-recheck-register.md). The rejected delivery is additional material to check, not an accepted audit. Historical source, test outputs and evidence classifications remain available as inputs. They carry no current completion credit. Completing the other 81 locales is outside this task.

Every assertion in the record below is a **withdrawn prior claim requiring full recheck**, including any statement that work was reviewed, implemented, repaired, complete, verified, preserved, or free of further defects. Prior lexical acceptance labels and test outcomes are historical inputs, not current task status.

[Original record at its previous commit](https://github.com/c933103/AN-Paint/blob/e51ab25c0fd4bfe10a8b4907ac3b7b9e30b42a26/verification/localization-pr3-pr4-handoff-review.md).
withdrawal_boundaries.interpretation: Earlier PR4 broad/manual/no-defect claims remain withdrawn. Source integration and historical CI do not restore acceptance. The October17 ledger and PR110 seven-value successors are separate post-reset bounded work, not restoration of September claims.
withdrawal_boundaries.public_independence_boundary: Broad ledger describes author/model per-entry judgments and independent mechanical source verification. Independent linguistic review is not established for its entire341. Original PR110 public description attests independent assessment of seven complete corrections only.
withdrawal_boundaries.excluded_full_help_boundary: Complete integrated Help and corrected warning successors are handled by the parent packet; no full Help acceptance is inferred from broad counts, filenames or fixture presence.
